$comment: Twi (Asante) urgent messages. DRAFT translation derived from en.json; needs native-speaker review and clinical adviser approval. Phone numbers and hrefs are byte-identical to en.json.

emergency.title: Ebia eyi yɛ asɛm a ɛhia mmoa ntɛm ara (emergency)
body: Nea woaka no betumi ayɛ asɛm a ɛyɛ den.
Ntwɛn nhwɛ sɛ ebeyɛ yie anaa.
App yi ntumi nhwɛ yare ho nsɛnkyerɛnne, na ɛntumi mma ayaresa ho afotu.
emergency.banner: Woaka biribi a ebia ɛyɛ asɛm a ɛhia mmoa ntɛm ara. Sɛ wonyɛɛ no da a, frɛ 999 seesei ara.

urgent.title: Mesrɛ wo, hwehwɛ mmoa ntɛm
body: Nea woaka no betumi ahia sɛ ɔyarehwɛfo hwɛ ntɛm.
Frɛ NHS 111 seesei, wɔ telefon so anaa intanɛt so, anaa frɛ wo GP surgery sɛ wɔabue a.
Sɛ ɛreyɛ den kɛse, anaa wususuw sɛ ɛyɛ emergency a, frɛ 999.
App yi ntumi nhwɛ yare ho nsɛnkyerɛnne, na ɛntumi mma ayaresa ho afotu.
urgent.banner: Woaka biribi a ebia ɛhia mmoa ntɛm. Sɛ wonyɛɛ no da a, frɛ NHS 111 anaa wo GP surgery.

crisis.title: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wo nko ara gyina eyi ano
body: Ɛte sɛ nea worefa biribi a ɛyɛ den yiye mu seesei.
Wobɛtumi ne Samaritans akasa kwa, bere biara, awia anaa anadwo. Frɛ 116 123.
Sɛ wowɔ asiane mu seesei, anaa ebia wobɛyɛ saa adwene yi so adwuma a, frɛ 999 seesei ara.
Wobɛtumi nso afrɛ NHS 111 ama adwenem yare ho mmoa ntɛm.
crisis.banner: Woaka sɛ ebia worefa biribi a ɛyɛ den mu. Samaritans wɔ hɔ bere biara wɔ 116 123. Sɛ wowɔ asiane mu seesei a, frɛ 999.
